data.situation:
At 5.30, Maya came back through the centre's front door. Jo and Ellen were at the volunteer desk, with a rota pinned above two empty boxes for books. Ellen said that volunteer work post-retirement had given her a regular reason to leave the house. That evening, she was helping a lending charity organise the collection of donated books. Its leaflet discussed poverty and educational inequality, including differences in access to books and a quiet place to study. Jo pointed out two shifts on the rota: one here and one at another building, both from six to eight. They were incompatible, so Ellen chose the desk at the centre. Maya unfolded the first box while Jo moved the second one away from the doorway. BOOK COLLECTION — SATURDAY EVENING
Donated books can be brought to the volunteer desk between six and eight. Please leave them in the boxes beside the table, not in the doorway. The charity’s leaflet explains why it lends books and discusses educational inequality. Volunteers should choose one of the two evening shifts; the times are incompatible.

readingBlocks.zh: 五点半，玛雅从中心正门回来了。乔和埃伦在志愿者桌旁，两只空书箱上方钉着一张值班表。埃伦说，退休后的志愿工作给了她一个定期出门的理由。当晚，她正帮助一家借阅慈善机构安排收集捐赠书籍。机构的传单谈到贫困和教育资源不平等，包括获得书籍、拥有安静学习空间的机会有何差异。乔指着值班表上的两个班次：一个在这里，一个在另一栋楼里，都是六点到八点。这两个安排无法兼顾，所以埃伦选择了中心的桌旁工作。玛雅撑开第一只折叠书箱，乔把第二只从门口挪开。

readingBlocks.en:
BOOK COLLECTION — SATURDAY EVENING
Donated books can be brought to the volunteer desk between six and eight. Please leave them in the boxes beside the table, not in the doorway. The charity’s leaflet explains why it lends books and discusses educational inequality. Volunteers should choose one of the two evening shifts; the times are incompatible.
readingBlocks.zh:
捐书收集——周六晚上
晚上六点至八点，可把捐赠的书带到志愿者桌旁。请把书放进桌边的箱子，不要堆在门口。机构传单介绍了它为什么开展借书服务，并讨论教育资源的不平等。志愿者应从两个晚班中选择一个；这两个时间安排无法兼顾。
